_comment: aimock (@copilotkit/aimock `llmock`) fixtures for the DeepSeek Harness reconstruction — the simulated OpenAI endpoint for cognate/test/J-*.test.ts, screenshot captures, and `just harness-up` (U1 of deepseek-harness-usage-features.md). Scenarios keep the old fixtures/mock-model/server.ts `[[scenario:<name>]]` markers as `match.userMessage` keys (aimock matches by substring against the last user turn). Multi-round tool loops use `toolCallId`-anchored follow-ups (ordered BEFORE their leg-1 fixture; leg 1 gated `hasToolResult: false`) with stable fixture-authored tool-call ids, so replay/restart serves the same script. Texts and tool arguments are copied byte-identically from the old mock where tests assert on them. Two honest divergences, both forced by aimock's static fixtures: (1) the old mock's `__REFLECT_TOOL_RESULT__` dynamic reflection is reproduced as static text — exact for every branch the tests exercise (allow/deny, approve/fail) thanks to `toolResultContains` gating, EXCEPT `delegate`, whose final text echoed a runtime-minted child run id (see the `delegate` entries); (2) a marker-less message no longer falls back to `plain` — aimock 404s it (`No fixture matched`), which J-AIM proves is surfaced as a run failure.
